meta.name: gmail
meta.description: This skill should be used when searching, fetching, or downloading emails from Gmail. Use for queries like "search Gmail for...", "find emails from John", "show unread emails", "emails about project X", or "download attachment from email".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速搜索、获取和下载Gmail中的邮件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要从Gmail中快速找到特定邮件或下载附件。
copy.tagline_en: Search, fetch, and download emails from your Gmail inbox quickly.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to quickly find specific emails or download attachments from Gmail.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能搜索、查看和下载你的 Gmail 邮件，支持按发件人、日期、附件等筛选，并列出邮件标签。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 搜索、查找或下载 Gmail 中的邮件时，例如说“搜索 Gmail 中关于会议记录的邮件”或“查找来自 John 的未读邮件”。

say.text: 搜索 Gmail 中关于项目 deadline 的邮件
say.note: Claude 会搜索匹配的邮件并列出摘要。

say.text: 查找来自 boss@company.com 的未读邮件
say.note: Claude 会筛选并展示未读邮件。

say.text: 下载最后一封有附件的邮件中的附件
say.note: Claude 会下载附件到默认目录。

howto.what_en: Claude can search, view, and download your Gmail emails. Supports filtering by sender, date, attachments, and listing labels.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to search, fetch, or download Gmail emails, e.g., "search Gmail for meeting notes" or "find emails from John".

say_en.text: Search Gmail for emails about project deadline
say_en.note: Claude will search and list matching emails.
Claude will filter and show unread results.

say_en.text: Download attachments from the last email with attachments
say_en.note: Claude will download attachments to default folder.
